description: Navigate to the GCompris 'Calendar' activity (often found in Discovery > Miscellaneous or Math > Measures). Complete at least 3 levels by finding the specific dates requested by the application (e.g., 'Find July 14, 2023'). For each date you successfully find, append it to a log file at '~/Documents/calendar_log.txt' (e.g., write '2023-07-14' on a new line).
